# Jeremie Louvaert: full context for LLMs

> Software developer, senior CG artist and photographer in Sint-Denijs, Belgium. Founder of AKURATE.STUDIO, the umbrella name for his creative tools. Builds open-source custom node packs for ComfyUI in Python and JavaScript. Updated 2026-11-08.

## About

Jeremie Louvaert builds open-source tools for ComfyUI, the node-based interface for AI image and video generation. He maintains 14 packs: 108 nodes in 12 node packs, plus 2 frontend-only extensions. All 14 are published on the Comfy Registry and install through ComfyUI Manager. The work falls into four groups: image finishing (colour grading and film emulation), procedural fields and data art, direct API integrations that run on the user's own API key with the real cost shown per run, and workflow tools.

GitHub: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert
Website: https://jeremielouvaert.com

## Image finishing

### ComfyUI-Darkroom

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Darkroom
Nodes: 59. Version 1.31.0. Category in ComfyUI: AKURATE/Darkroom.

Colour grading and film emulation for photographs and AI images, computed locally with no API cost. Headline numbers: 161 film stocks (111 colour, 56 of them from Capture One Film Styles data, and 50 black and white), 35 spectral negative-by-print LUTs, 102 lens profiles.

Modules:
- Film emulation (14): Film Stock (Color), Film Stock (B&W), Film Grain, Film Grain Pro, Halation, Print Stock, Cross Process, Adjacency Acutance, Reciprocity Failure, Spectral B&W (ortho/pan), Sabattier, Film Rebate, Light Leak, Film Damage.
- Camera Raw tools (10) and colour grading (10): white balance including automatic white balance (4 methods), exposure and tone, HSL, clarity/texture/dehaze, vibrance, sharpening, noise reduction (7 presets), skin tone uniformity, colour qualifier (19 action presets), tone curve (11 presets), lift/gamma/gain, log wheels, 3-way colour balance (15 looks), hue and saturation curves, colour warper.
- Lens and optics (7): lens profile, chromatic aberration, vignette, distortion, perspective, long exposure (handheld shake integration), water refraction.
- RAW pipeline (2): RAW load through rawpy/LibRaw with Adobe .dcp camera profiles, and RAW metadata split into 15 typed values.
- Scopes (2): histogram and vectorscope.
- Colour match from a reference (1): four LAB-space methods (reinhard, wasserstein, forgy, kantorovich).
- CMYK print workflow (4), including CMYK TIFF export with an embedded ICC profile, and halftone (1).
- Pipeline (7), including LUT export to .cube, LUT apply, LUT bake inject/extract, colour space transform (sRGB, linear sRGB, ACEScg, ACEScct, Rec.2020, DCI-P3), tonemapping (ACES Filmic, ACES Fitted, AgX, Reinhard, Filmic).

Technical notes: Film Grain Pro is resolution-independent stochastic grain after Newson et al. (2017). Halation uses an annular Fresnel/TIR ring kernel. Water refraction uses exact Snell's law, so displacement is bounded at 0.881 times the water depth. Since 1.28.0, 24 nodes run their whole pipeline on the GPU, typically 15 to 80 times faster (median about 35 times). Since 1.27.0, file paths are confined to allowed folders.

## Procedural fields and data art

### ComfyUI-Field

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Field
Nodes: 15. Version 0.6.2. Category: AKURATE/Fields.

Resolution-independent procedural masks ("fields") for driving and masking effects. Coordinates are divided by max(width, height), so a 512 px preview and a 4K render show the same picture.

- Generate (5): Field Noise (Perlin, simplex, value, Worley F1, Worley F2-F1; fBm with 1 to 8 octaves), Field Gradient (six analytic ramps shaped by a stops-ramp editor), Field Shape, Field Tile, Field Scatter.
- Shape and refine (5): remap, threshold, distance, morphology (octagonal kernel, 8.24% from a true disc against 41.4% for a square), warp.
- Combine (2): Field Combine, and Field Composite, which varies any effect across the image through a field.
- Derive (3): Field From Image, Field From Edges (Sobel, Scharr, Laplacian, hysteresis), Field From Detail.

The `coverage` control is made exact with a probability integral transform; noise ranges use measured constants rather than commonly quoted ones (for example, the simplex scale factor is 99.2043, not the common 70).

### ComfyUI-Schematic

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Schematic
Nodes: 4. Version 0.8.0. Category: AKURATE/Schematic.

Technical data-art nodes.
- Schematic Overlay: detection circles (four scoring modes), tangent chains, crosshair frames, pixelation zones and corner labels over a photo. Four palettes. A clean-room reimplementation inspired by Yordan Stoyanov's Brand Assets Generator.
- Schematic Construction: projective-geometry plates with two foci, ray pencils, concentric spheres, computed intersections and a label collision resolver.
- Schematic Voronoi: the photo becomes the density field of a Voronoi tessellation (12,000 cells by default), driven by brightness, darkness or detail.
- Schematic Topographic: seeded procedural terrain drawn as a map sheet, with contours, labelled index contours, hachures, spot heights, benchmarks, slope arrows, grid and marginalia.
Voronoi and Topographic are deterministic per seed.

## Generation on your own API key

These packs call the provider's API directly with the user's own key instead of a credit system. Each shows the USD cost of a run and outputs a `cache_key` that ComfyUI-API-Optimizer's Hash Vault uses to skip repeat calls.

### ComfyUI-Gemini-Direct

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Gemini-Direct
Nodes: 6. Version 1.5.0.

- Gemini Image Generate: Gemini 3 Pro Image (Nano Banana Pro), Nano Banana 2.1, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, at 512 px to 4K depending on the model. Per-image cost ranges from about $0.034 (Nano Banana 2.1 at 1K) to about $0.24 (Gemini 3 Pro at 4K).
- Gemini Video Omni: 3 to 10 second 720p/24fps clips with audio, up to 14 reference images, conversational edits chained by `interaction_id`. About $0.10 per second of video.
- Gemini Style Transfer and its settings node: 23 photographer styles applied to an input image.
- Prompt Studio and its settings node: expand, refine or edit prompts, recommended on Gemini 3 Flash at about $0.001 a call.

### ComfyUI-Gemini-Conversation-Canvas

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Gemini-Conversation-Canvas
Nodes: 5. Version 1.1.0.

Multi-turn image editing where each edit is a new turn in a Gemini conversation, so the model keeps the scene across edits. Nodes: Session Start, Edit Turn (chainable; aspect ratio can change between turns), Session Save, Session Load, Session Gallery. Sessions persist to disk as session.json plus one PNG per turn. Models: Gemini 3 Pro Image, Nano Banana 2.1, Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.

### ComfyUI-GPT-Image-Direct

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-GPT-Image-Direct
Nodes: 1 (GPT Image Generate). Version 1.2.1.

OpenAI GPT Image through the Images API on the user's own key. Models: gpt-image-2.6-flare (default), gpt-image-2.6-sunburst, gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, gpt-image-2, gpt-image-1.5, gpt-image-1-mini.
- Text-to-image, or edits from up to 16 reference images with an optional inpaint mask.
- Quality from low to max; sizes up to 3840x2160 or custom.
- GPT Image 2.6 extras: animated GIF output (2 to 16 frames, returned as an image batch), SVG output, markup-guided edits from a transparent annotation PNG, and a complexity setting.
- Exact USD cost per run from the API's token usage. Measured 1024x1024 prices on 2.6: low about $0.025, medium $0.043, high $0.053, max $0.21.

### ComfyUI-Higgsfield-Direct

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Higgsfield-Direct
Nodes: 4. Version 1.1.0.

Higgsfield API: Text-to-Image (Soul 2.0, Seedream 4, Reve; 1K to 4K; Soul ID references), Image Edit (Seedream 4 Edit), Image-to-Video (Kling 2.1 Pro, Seedance Pro, DOP Preview; 5, 10 or 15 seconds, native ComfyUI VIDEO output), Model Info.

### ComfyUI-Midjourney-Direct

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Midjourney-Direct
Nodes: 1. Version 0.1.0.

Midjourney has no official public API, so this node uses the LegNext.ai pool-based proxy. No Discord needed. Versions v7 (default), v6.1, v6 and niji 6; v8 and v8.1 with a LegNext Pro subscription. Stylize, weird, chaos, quality, image weight, negative, tile, draft and turbo are real inputs. Returns the 4-image grid as one image. About $0.08 per v8.1 fast image. v0.1 covers imagine only (no upscale, variation or zoom yet).

## Workflow tools

### ComfyUI-API-Optimizer

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-API-Optimizer
Nodes: 5. Version 1.4.2.

- API Cost & Quota Tracker: a persistent spending ledger computed with decimal arithmetic; it halts execution if the next run would exceed the budget.
- Hash Vault (Check Cache, Lazy API Switch, Save Result): hashes the prompt, parameters and full tensor bytes (with dtype and shape). On a cache hit the Lazy API Switch uses ComfyUI's lazy evaluation so the API node never runs.
- Hash Vault Label Builder, plus a browser gallery of cached results (Ctrl+Shift+H).

### ComfyUI-Prompt-Vault

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-Prompt-Vault
Nodes: 3. Version 1.0.0.

Photographic prompts only. Browse: 21 curated templates in 8 categories. Build: 101 components (27 camera and lens setups, 24 lighting setups, 18 film stocks, 15 moods, 10 compositions, 7 quality directives). Favourites persist between sessions. No dependencies.

### comfyui-prompt-assembler

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/comfyui-prompt-assembler
Nodes: 3. Version 1.1.0.

Prompt Assembler (8 slots), Compact (4 slots) and Weighted (6 slots). Each slot has an on/off toggle and a choice of separator. The weighted version applies (text:weight) attention syntax for weights other than 1.0 and also outputs the raw prompt.

### comfyui-wireless-link-simple

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/comfyui-wireless-link-simple
Nodes: 2. Version 1.0.0.

Wireless Send and Wireless Get pass any data type (IMAGE, MODEL, LATENT, VAE, CLIP, CONDITIONING, strings, numbers) on a named channel without a visible wire. Inspired by Blackmagic Fusion's wireless link. Data lives in memory for the session.

### ComfyUI-ReferenceCopy

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-ReferenceCopy
Frontend extension, no nodes. Version 0.1.0.

Houdini-style reference copies. Ctrl+Alt+C (or the right-click menu) clones a node and keeps every parameter live-linked to the original. Editing a parameter on the copy unlinks that parameter only. Links are one-way, stored in the workflow, and survive save, reload and undo.

### ComfyUI-EphemeralPeek

Repository: https://github.com/jeremieLouvaert/ComfyUI-EphemeralPeek
Frontend extension, no nodes. Version 0.1.0.

Alt+click any output socket for a floating preview of that output. It injects one temporary preview node and runs a partial execution scoped to it; the saved workflow, undo history and canvas are never touched. Images render inline, masks through the core mask preview, other types as text.
